mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain depressed while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, weekday footfall will stay weak and retail visits will be lower over the next four weeks because commuting and out-of-home trip chains are not recovering.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC averages higher over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES stays below baseline and RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-week drop in PARKS mobility spills into lower discretionary outings to shops and restaurants within two weeks, so RETAIL_REC falls after park-going collapses because leisure trips and shopping trips move together.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls at least 15 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -21.3 at t-2w to -43.7 at t-1w before recovering to -28.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not decline within the next 14 days after a week-on-week PARKS drop of 15 points or more, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM is above baseline and RESIDENTIAL is also above baseline, routine neighborhood errands sustain nearby commercial trips, keeping RETAIL_REC flat to slightly higher over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL were both positive at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC falls in the next 7 days while GROCERY_PHARM and RESIDENTIAL both remain above baseline, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A further weekly deterioration in TRANSIT indicates tighter movement frictions or lower confidence in shared transport, which then suppresses mall and dining trips with a four-week lag and pushes RETAIL_REC down.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -40 and stays there for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT reached -44.6 at t-1w and remained near that level at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC is not lower over the next 28 days after TRANSIT remains below -40 for two straight weeks, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of weaker WORKPLACES mobility and weaker TRANSIT mobility reduces daytime and evening customer flows to retail districts, so retail-and-recreation mobility declines over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay below baseline, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS combined with a rebound in TRANSIT signals more discretionary outings and easier access to public places, which should lift RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 10 points and TRANSIT rises by at least 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -43.7 at t-1w to -28.0 at t-0w
fact:TRANSIT moved from -44.6 at t-1w to -38.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days after simultaneous gains in PARKS and TRANSIT, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL remains above baseline during a steady monsoon-like stay-at-home period, local demand is shifted toward neighborhood purchases and retail mobility falls only if the home-stay signal weakens; otherwise RETAIL_REC stays below its prior four-week mean over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed positive in all four weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above baseline throughout, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A short-lived transit shock followed by persistent workplace weakness creates a lagged drag on shopping trips: once TRANSIT is below -35 and WORKPLACES is below -15, retail mobility should underperform the prior month for the next month.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -35 and WORKPLACES stays below -15 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -35.7 or lower in all four weeks
fact:WORKPLACES was -22.4 at t-1w and -20.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not fall below its previous 4-week average after two weeks of TRANSIT below -35 and WORKPLACES below -15, the hypothesis fails.
